text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Let's have fun today!
Everyone, let's enjoy ourselves to the absolute fullest!

text_block_list.name: Gyaru Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
'Sup, nice to meet ya.
...Well, looking forward to working with ya.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
To think everyone here is an upperclassman...
Ugh, I'm getting super nervous...
choice_data_list: (Sigh, of course it'd turn out like this.)
(Sigh, of course this is how it turns out.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gathered here are Academy students meeting for the first time,
brought together by Casino Drive's call for assistance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The plan is to put the insights gained from the Synergy Project into practice...
and get them to open up to each other.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Well then... to break the ice, please have this.
I picked it up at the shop just a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Gyaru Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thanks.
...Well, down the hatch—

text_block_list.name: Gyaru Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wait, it's so sweeeeeet!!
It's loaded with whipped cream! Haha!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this shop appears to have quite the variety...
There are many other flavors available as well.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Oh, is this kimchi? It's deliciously spicy... and feels quite refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Gyaru Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~... Hey, can I have a bite?
I'll share my whipped cream with you!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Yes!
I was just starting to crave something sweet myself...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Just a bit more and it's a new high score!
Let's defend the Earth from the aliens!

text_block_list.name: Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, everyone's so amazing...
The enemy has so much HP, I can't take them down at all...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
(――! Should I go help...?
No, right now I should――)

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
(I'll step forward and lure the enemies out...
then take them down as a team!)

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: —Now! Provide backup!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yes! Fire magic, gooooo!

text_block_list.name: Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that's massive damage...! ...With that much HP left, maybe I can... Hyah!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! That's a massive score all at once!
At this rate, you'll definitely break your high score!

text_block_list.name: Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah!
Thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Gyaru Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, you've done that much self-training already!?
Seriously too impressive! Aren't you overdoing it a bit?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm on the smaller side... I want to train my body more
and win even more races!

text_block_list.name: Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me...
Would it be okay if we practiced together?
...To be honest, my times haven't really improved lately――

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
How amazing……!
I never imagined it would be this incredible……!
choice_data_list: The team atmosphere is really coming together nicely.
The team atmosphere is really coming together nicely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If we can have fun together and bare our true selves, we can share each other's problems and vulnerabilities too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: By doing so, we should be able to forge a relationship where we understand, support, and move forward together.
choice_data_list: ――As a trainer, it's great reference material.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san, care to take a walk?
I'll let the others know.

text_block_list.name: Zombie A
text_block_list.text: Boo-yaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, watch out!?
T-Trainer! Run away!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: That was close... T-They're not chasing us anymore, right?
choice_data_list: W-Why a haunted house all of a sudden...!?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...I apologize. I thought that today... no,
that with you, I might be able
to overcome my fear.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Let us continue our conversation from earlier.
A team grows by understanding and supporting one another.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
That's right, exactly as you say.
That is an indispensable point for any team.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: —For both me and you.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
You've listened to so many of my stories.
About my past, and about my sisters. But—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: I haven't had a chance to properly hear what you have to say yet.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...I want to get to know you.
I want us to support each other and move forward together.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Because we are a team, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Bong, bong...)

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
........Shall we get going soon?
We never know when a zombie might pop up.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Could this be... a treasure chest?
It's quite dirty... and somewhat eerie.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She told me she wanted to know more about me.
I found myself wanting to answer that wish.
choice_data_list: ...Speaking of which, I dropped my wallet a while back.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—! ...Fufu, what an ordeal that must have been.
How did you manage to find it—

text_block_list.name: Zombie B
text_block_list.text: Baaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Trainer, there's another zombie!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Well... even while we run,
could you tell me the rest of what you were saying earlier?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... Why not! Please tell me all about it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, as we scrambled around looking for the exit,
the two of us chatted about all sorts of silly little things.
